title: Sampled-out requests fill the annotation store and starve admitted active requests
claim: BindScope stores Sampled:false annotations for sampled-out/capacity-dropped scopes; store capacity is MaxConcurrentRequests (default 2) and trimStore only evicts dead keys, so an admitted active request gets no annotation, no owner binding, and no orphan capacity; 30-70% of active requests lose all findings at 3-16 in-flight requests with default config.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run 'TestReviewSampledOutRequestsStarveActiveRequest|TestReviewSampledOutStarvationRate' -v ./internal/spans/ (after copying evidence test files into internal/spans/ of a private copy)

title: Spans created after root Finish resurrect an annotation keyed on the finished root, leaking a slot and silently discarding findings
claim: Finished deletes without a tombstone; later BindScope/AnnotationFor via child spans (woven StartSpanFromContext) or weak-crypto Report re-create a never-finished entry keyed on the finished root, occupying a store slot while the trace is reachable (blocks new requests at default capacity 2) and accepting commits (plus dedup hash) that are never emitted.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run 'TestReviewLateBindAfterRootFinishLeaksSlot|TestReviewLateBindActiveScopeSilentlyDropsCommittedFinding' -v ./internal/spans/ (after copying evidence test files into internal/spans/ of a private copy)

title: With dd-trace-go span pool, a recycled root inherits another trace's annotation (cross-trace bleed or false negative)
claim: The store key is only weak.Pointer[tracer.Span]; with DD_TRACER_EXPERIMENTAL_SPAN_POOL_ENABLED/WithSpanPool the same object is reused for a new trace root, whose BindScope returns the stale annotation carrying foreign findings, or a stale negative decision that disables an admitted active request.

title: Finished runs weak.Make on every finished span in the process, even with IAST disabled
claim: The woven Span.Finish hook calls weak.Make for every span, allocating a weak handle and runtime special (1 alloc/op measured) even with config.Enabled=false and an empty store.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run 'TestReviewFinishedAllocatesPerSpan' -v ./internal/spans/ (after copying evidence test files into internal/spans/ of a private copy)

title: Request admission drops up to about 30% of scopes under plain concurrency with free capacity
claim: Store.Acquire returns disabled on ownerMu.TryLock failure (and skips writersMu-contended slots); 8 concurrent Begin calls with 64 free slots dropped 0-387 of 1200 admissions.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run 'TestReviewAdmissionDropsUnderConcurrency' -v ./internal/spans/ (after copying evidence test files into internal/spans/ of a private copy)

title: No test exercises GC, recycling, or post-finish binding on the span association
claim: Existing tests keep spans strongly reachable, never force GC or observe weak collection/trim, and never bind after root finish or with span pooling; F1-F3 are invisible to the suite.

title: Dead-annotation release and its source-byte charge depend on an unrelated later bind
claim: A collected never-finished root keeps its processEventSourceBytes charge until some later trimStore call; bounded but can make other commits fail meanwhile.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run 'TestReviewAbandonedSpanReclaimed' -v ./internal/spans/ (after copying evidence test files into internal/spans/ of a private copy)

title: Owner binding keeps a closed annotation (with its Event) alive after the root finishes
claim: ownerSpanBinding holds a strong *Annotation until scope finish or dead-root lookup; bounded by 64 slots.
